acceptance: Completed and timed-out BigQuery runs with a configured location keep it in platform_info, so cost validation does not warn and normalized cost has a pricing region.
context: Filed 2026-11-25 at the close of the run-timeout effort (umbrella run-timeout-plan-20261120, done). Evidence read that day; re-read code, docs and run folders before acting.
description:
## Problem
On 2026-11-25 two BigQuery TPC-H SF 0.01 runs stopped at their limit (exit 124; `~/Developer/benchmark_runs/run-timeout-live-check-20261124/a1t/run.log` and `a2b/run.log`) logged `Platform config validation: Missing required config field 'location' for bigquery cost calculation`, `Platform configuration incomplete for bigquery` and `normalized cost unavailable: pricing region metadata missing for bigquery`, so normalized cost was dropped, although `~/.benchbox/credentials.yaml` sets `location: US`. The cost config comes from `_extract_platform_config_from_results` (`benchbox/core/cost/integration.py`), which reads `location`, `dataset_location` or `cloud_region` from `results.platform_info`. The 2026-09-26 write_primitives probe log (`~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/live-cloud-corpus-20260926/write_primitives_catalog_v2_sf001_bigquery_isolated_probe.log`) also warns; the 2026-09-29 read_primitives run did not, so the gap depends on the path (possibly the timed-out partial-result path, `mark_timed_out` / `write_hard_stop_result`).

## Change
Find which result paths reach cost estimation with `platform_info` lacking the location (completed vs timed-out vs the primitives runners), and make them record the adapter's effective non-secret location in `platform_info`. Check other platforms with required cost fields for the same gap.

## Decision gates
- Never pass secrets (keys, tokens, credential file contents) into cost metadata or result files.
- If the region used for pricing changes, say so in the changelog; do not change prices.

## Verification rubric
Pass: stubbed tests for a completed and a timed-out BigQuery run with location set show no missing-field warning and a pricing region in normalized cost, failing before; `make pr-preflight` exits 0.
Fail: either path still warns, or any secret appears in the result.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
